digest.component_or_area: store git operations / local lock contention handling
propositions: Local git call sites across rebar store operations (compact, delete, fsck, txn, event_append, metrics) contend unbounded on shared lock files (.git/index.lock, ref locks, config.lock) under high concurrent local agent use, surfacing errors to the caller instead of absorbing them.

Per-store advisory lock (fcntl-based rebar-git-op.lock) plus bounded jittered retry with exponential backoff on git's own lock signatures must serialize local writers and enable transient lock conflicts to self-heal silently within a tens-of-seconds budget.
Permanently held locks (budget exhausted) must surface exactly one actionable error naming the contended lock file and providing holder guidance rather than generic or silent failures.
Uncontended store git operations must incur zero added latency on the happy path (non-blocking advisory lock, no sleep when uncontended).

All local-only git call sites must be bounded with a watchdog timeout justified against local filesystem latency (120s for index-touching operations, 300s for metric walks holding no store lock) or explicitly documented as deliberately unbounded with rationale.

Store lock acquisition sleeps (50ms, 100ms) and index-lock retry backoff must be jittered uniformly [0.75, 1.25] to de-synchronize thundering-herd contention under high agent counts, and the blocking policy must be stated as bounded jittered retry with silent transient recovery and one actionable error on stuck locks.
